description: Month-end assets under management (AUD millions) of the spot Bitcoin ETFs quoted on the ASX (VBTC, BTXX, QBTC, IBIT), by fund with issuer and management fee, plus the previous month's total. Use this for questions about Australian Bitcoin ETFs, their size or fees. Monthly data from the ASX Investment Products report, published a few weeks after month end, so it lags; it does not cover US-listed ETFs (use get_bitcoin_etf_flows).
name: get_australian_bitcoin_etfs
title: Australian Bitcoin ETFs
